intents.name: create_account
intents.description: Get instructions for account registration.
intents.strategy: Use the supplied registration FAQ; do not invent URLs or verification requirements.

intents.name: password_reset
intents.description: Recover access using the official password-reset flow.
exampleQueries: How do I recover my login?
intents.strategy: Direct the user to the official login page and Forgot Password control; never collect secrets.

intents.name: account_profile_change
intents.description: Change registered email, phone, address, or profile information.
intents.strategy: Use authenticated approved workflow only.

intents.name: account_security
intents.description: Respond to suspicious access, account takeover, or unauthorized changes.
exampleQueries: I see a login I don't recognize
intents.strategy: Do not request passwords or codes; initiate secure account-protection handoff.

intents.name: contact_support
intents.description: Find approved support channel or request a person.
intents.strategy: Share only a confirmed channel; create no unconfirmed ticket.

intents.name: product_information
intents.description: Ask about approved product features, variants, price, stock, or warranty.
exampleQueries: Does this product have a warranty?
intents.strategy: Answer from current approved catalogue only.

intents.name: place_order
intents.description: Get help with checkout or order creation.
exampleQueries: How do I place an order?
intents.strategy: Use verified checkout guidance; do not claim an order exists without system confirmation.

intents.name: order_tracking
intents.description: Check current order progress or tracking.
intents.strategy: Requires live trusted order/tracking status; current app has no integration.

intents.name: modify_order
intents.description: Change item, quantity, address, or instructions after order creation.
intents.strategy: Check current fulfillment state and authorized change action.

intents.name: cancel_order
intents.description: Request cancellation and understand any confirmed next step.
exampleQueries: Can I stop a shipped order?
intents.strategy: Check approved policy and system state; never claim cancellation without confirmation.

intents.name: delayed_delivery
intents.description: Resolve an order that is later than a verified estimate or target.
intents.strategy: Use verified status and approved delay threshold; do not invent ETA.

intents.name: delivered_not_received
intents.description: Investigate an order marked delivered that the customer did not receive.
exampleQueries: It says delivered but I don't have it
intents.strategy: Use approved proof-of-delivery and logistics investigation workflow.

intents.name: missing_wrong_or_damaged_item
intents.description: Report incorrect, missing, partial, or damaged contents.
intents.strategy: Verify order lines and current policy; collect evidence only through approved channel.

intents.name: payment_failed_or_pending
intents.description: Troubleshoot failed, pending, or timed-out payment.
intents.strategy: Verify payment state before suggesting retry.

intents.name: charged_without_order
intents.description: Investigate a debit or capture without a confirmed order.
exampleQueries: Money was deducted but no order appeared
intents.strategy: Reconcile payment and order systems; never promise automatic reversal timing.

intents.name: refund_status
intents.description: Check whether a refund was approved, initiated, or completed.
intents.strategy: Use verified refund transaction; distinguish approval, initiation, and provider posting.
escalationConditions: Refund state unavailable or overdue under approved rule

intents.name: return_or_replacement
intents.description: Ask for return/replacement eligibility or procedure.
intents.strategy: Apply current product-specific approved policy; demo rule is not approved.

intents.name: invoice_or_billing
intents.description: Resolve invoice, tax, unexpected charge, or billing amount issue.
intents.strategy: Compare system-generated itemized bill and applicable approved tax rules.

intents.name: coupon_or_offer
intents.description: Troubleshoot an offer, coupon, discount, referral, or reward.
intents.strategy: Check effective offer terms and checkout calculation.

intents.name: technical_issue
intents.description: Diagnose website, app, network, or integration trouble.
intents.strategy: Use safe reversible diagnostics and avoid repeated financial actions.

intents.name: complaint_or_dispute
intents.description: Record poor experience, conduct complaint, repeated failure, or unresolved case.
intents.strategy: Acknowledge, classify, record minimal facts, route to owner.

intents.name: food_safety_or_restaurant_issue
intents.description: Conditional intent for a confirmed food-service business.
intents.strategy: Do not make medical or allergen guarantees; prioritize safety and escalate.

intents.name: seller_vendor_support
intents.description: Conditional partner-only request about onboarding, listing, settlement, or fulfilment.
exampleQueries: How do I update a listing?
intents.strategy: Use separate authenticated partner channel; never expose internal procedures to customers.

intents.name: subscription_membership
intents.description: Conditional request about plan, renewal, cancellation, or benefits.
exampleQueries: Why was I charged for renewal?
intents.strategy: Only answer if a program is confirmed; verify current membership state.

intents.name: privacy_data_request
intents.description: Request access, correction, deletion, or report of privacy concern.
intents.strategy: Route through approved privacy verification and rights workflow.

intents.name: speak_to_agent
intents.description: Customer explicitly requests a human.
exampleQueries: Let me speak to a person
intents.strategy: Stop bot loop and hand off through configured channel.

intents.name: unknown_or_unsupported
intents.description: No sufficiently relevant approved information is available.
exampleQueries: Question about an undocumented ShopEase service
intents.strategy: State the knowledge limitation; ask one useful clarification or offer confirmed support route; never guess.
